findings.problem: Line 5 (a good line) quotes "Search me, O God, and know my heart." In the BSB, Psalm 139:23 continues after "heart" with a semicolon: "Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my concerns." The quote cuts the verse short and replaces the semicolon with a period, so the punctuation inside the quotation marks doesn't match the BSB. Fix: quote the full verse, or drop the quotation marks and paraphrase.

rule.text: Quotation marks around Bible words mean the exact BSB wording, punctuation included. A paraphrase uses no quotation marks.
